chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who strikes a woman and she miscarries the nuṭfah, and he said: “He is liable for twenty dinars.” I said: If he strikes her and she miscarries the ʿalaqah? He said: “Forty dinars.” I said: If he strikes her and she miscarries the muḍghah? He said: “He is liable for sixty dinars.” I said: If he strikes her and she miscarries it after bone has formed for it? He said: “He is liable for the full diyah, and by this Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام judged.”

I said: What is the description of the nuṭfah by which it is recognized? He said: “The nuṭfah is white, like thick mucus, and it remains in the رحم; when it has been there for forty days, it then becomes an ʿalaqah.” I said: What is the description of the formation of the ʿalaqah by which it is recognized? He said: “It is an ʿalaqah like a clotted mass of cupped blood, congealed; it remains in the رحم for forty days after its transformation from the nuṭfah, then it becomes a muḍghah.” I said: What is the description of the formation of the muḍghah and its form by which it is recognized? He said: “It is a muḍghah, red flesh, in which are interwoven green veins; then it becomes bone.” I said: What is the description of its creation when it is bone? He said: “When it is bone, hearing and sight are opened for it and its limbs are arranged; when it is like that, then the full diyah applies for it.”

key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: financial compensation due for bodily harm or unlawful killing
key_terms.الرَّحِمِ: the womb, where the embryo develops
key_terms.النُّطْفَةُ: the initial embryonic drop stage of pregnancy
key_terms.الْعَلَقَةَ: the clinging or clot-like embryonic stage after the nuṭfah
key_terms.الْمُضْغَةَ: the chewed-like lump of flesh stage of embryonic development
key_terms.جَوَارِحُهُ: its limbs or bodily organs arranged in formation
key_terms.دِينَارًا: a gold coin used here as the measure of legal compensation
key_terms.عَظْمًا: the stage at which bone has formed in the fetus

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for causing a miscarriage at different stages of fetal development in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings on compensation for causing a miscarriage at different stages of fetal development. It also describes the recognizable stages of the embryo—nuṭfah, ʿalaqah, muḍghah, and bone formation—and assigns increasing financial liability, reaching full diyah once the fetus has formed bone and its faculties and limbs are set in order.
